The season, which was named "[[Juan Izquierdo|Juan Manuel Izquierdo]]",{{Cite web |url=https://www.elobservador.com.uy/futbol/el-campeonato-uruguayo-2025-llevara-el-nombre-juan-izquierdo-debido-un-gesto-que-tuvo-defensor-sporting-n5980886 |title=El Campeonato Uruguayo 2025 llevará el nombre de Juan Izquierdo debido a un gesto que tuvo Defensor Sporting |trans-title=The 2025 Campeonato Uruguayo will be named Juan Izquierdo due to a gesture by Defensor Sporting |publisher=[[El Observador (Uruguay)|El Observador]] |language=es |date=21 January 2025 |access-date=22 January 2025}} began on 31 January and ended on 30 November 2025.{{cite web|url=https://www.montevideo.com.uy/Deportes/El-Campeonato-Uruguayo-2025-Sin-actividad-en-julio-y-con-tres-fechas-entre-semana-uc907684 |title=El Campeonato Uruguayo 2025: Sin actividad en julio y con tres fechas entre semana |trans-title=The 2025 ''Campeonato Uruguayo'': Without activity in July and with three mid-week rounds |publisher=Montevideo Portal |language=es |date=26 November 2024 |access-date=10 December 2024}}{{cite web|url=https://www.montevideo.com.uy/Deportes/-Como-cuando-y-donde-se-definira-la-Liga-AUF-Uruguaya-con-finales-clasicas--uc943431 |title=¿Cómo, cuándo y dónde se definirá la Liga AUF Uruguaya con finales clásicas? |trans-title=How, when and where will the Liga AUF Uruguaya be settled with derby finals? |publisher=Montevideo Portal |language=es |date=17 November 2025 |access-date=17 November 2025}} [[Club Nacional de Football|Nacional]] were the champions, winning their fiftieth league championship after topping the season's aggregate table and defeating the defending champions [[Peñarol]] in the finals.{{cite web|url=https://www.montevideo.com.uy/Deportes/Nacional-se-consagro-Campeon-Uruguayo-al-vencer-1-0-a-Penarol-de-forma-agonica-en-el-GPC-uc944969 |title=Nacional se consagró Campeón Uruguayo al vencer 1-0 a Peñarol de forma agónica en el GPC |trans-title=Nacional were crowned Uruguayan Champions after a dramatic 1–0 victory over Peñarol at the GPC |publisher=Montevideo Portal |language=es |date=30 November 2025 |access-date=30 November 2025}} ==Teams== 16 teams competed in the season: the top thirteen teams in the [[2024 Uruguayan Primera División season#Relegation|relegation table]] of the 2024 season as well as three promoted teams from the [[2024 Uruguayan Segunda División season|Segunda División]]. The three lowest placed teams in the relegation table of the 2024 season ([[Rampla Juniors]], [[Centro Atlético Fénix|Fénix]] and [[Deportivo Maldonado]]) were relegated to the [[Uruguayan Segunda División|Segunda División]] for the 2025 season. They were replaced by the Segunda División champions [[Club Plaza Colonia de Deportes|Plaza Colonia]], the runners-up [[Montevideo City Torque]], and the winners of the promotion play-offs [[Juventud de Las Piedras|Juventud]]. Plaza Colonia and City Torque both returned to the top flight after one season and Juventud played in Primera División for the first time since [[2019 Uruguayan Primera División season|2019]], while Rampla Juniors were relegated after one season, Fénix returned to the second tier after a 14-year spell in Primera División, and Deportivo Maldonado were relegated after five seasons. ===Stadiums and locations=== {{location map+ |Uruguay |float=right |width=450 |caption=Locations of the 2025 season teams outside [[Montevideo]]. |places= {{location map~ |Uruguay |lat=-34.90 |long=-56.15 |label=
